name: native-desktop
description: Native desktop menus, tray icons, clipboard formats, drag and drop, and window, trash and volume access, independent of application and rendering frameworks.
releasenote: Menus report opening and closing and can be changed as they open. Tray icons report where they are clicked and their mouse buttons. New: the clipboard's HTML, rich text, URL, file and image formats; drag and drop in and out of a window; stacking, moving and resizing a window; moving files to the trash; and the mounted storage volumes.
